unknown.label: Unknown embedder
unknown.notes: Do not claim exact compatibility without source, flags and snapshot evidence.

node.label: Node.js
node.snapshot: Node startup snapshot or verified read-only snapshot checksum
node.notes: Nearby versioned Node runtimes may be discovered automatically, but snapshot identity still matters.

electron.label: Electron
electron.profile_backend: version and layout only unless embedder evidence is supplied
electron.d8_backend: preferred when a matching patched d8 is available
electron.notes: Electron may use different flags, runtime tables and startup snapshots than upstream Node or d8.

chromium.label: Chromium
chromium.profile_backend: version and layout only unless embedder evidence is supplied
chromium.d8_backend: preferred when a matching patched d8 is available
chromium.notes: Chromium builds can diverge from upstream V8 through build flags and embedder data.

custom.label: Custom embedder
custom.d8_backend: requires matching patched d8 or a custom adapter
custom.notes: Add a versioned adapter when the embedder changes source layout or runtime tables.
